from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperReference(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single paper regarding its citation relations."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper being processed")
    referenced_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers explicitly cited in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate of all extracted paper information from the document collection."""
    papers: list[PaperReference]
